issues.summary: Together, the product-view card (773e02f, from tracking) and the ad-variant card (25611e3, from landings) report the wrong product view to Meta for the Birthstone Heart Necklace month ads. The page opens on the month the ad names (for example May), but ViewContent still names January · Garnet (50651969093794). AddToCart and the wishlist heart name May. The card 773e02f promises that product views report the variant the page opens on, and that breaks here. Neither branch had this on its own. On own-tracking the page opened on January and reported January. The two cards were never run together.

It compares the variant JewelDetailNext opens on, `variantChoice(p, variantLink) ?? openingChoice(p, colourParam)`, with the one `viewContentParams(piece, colourParam)` names. Over 103 bundled ?variant= links there are 11 mismatches, all of them birthstone-heart-necklace February to December. Example: ?variant=50651969224866 (May · Emerald) opens on 50651969224866, but ViewContent names 50651969093794. I confirmed it in the browser on my own `npx vite build` of the head, served on port 4497 with Pixel 7 emulation, Meta and the relay aborted and Fastrr stubbed (probe/vc-browser.mjs, output probe/vc-browser.json). /jewellery/birthstone-heart-necklace?variant=50651969224866 shows select 'May · Emerald', and the fbq queue has ViewContent content_ids ['50651969093794'] at value 699. The October ad gives the same result. The Triple Coil Silver ad is correct (50651931672738). issues.summary: On head, a catalogue ad link that names a Birthstone Heart Necklace month opens the page on that month, and Add to cart sends that month. The product view still names January, in both the pixel and the server copy. So within one visit, ViewContent and AddToCart name different catalogue items. The cause: the page opens on variantChoice(piece, ?variant=) (from 25611e3 and its fixups), but viewContentParams only reads openingChoice(piece, colourParam).
